SELECT #{prodId} as SHORTNAME, --产品代码 CAST((#{netUnitValue}) as Char(200)) NETVALUE, --报文体：净值 CAST((#{cdate}) NAVDATE as Char(200)) , --报文体：净值日期 CAST((#{cdate}) USEDATE as Char(200)), ----报文体：生效日 CAST((#{assetValue}) as Char(200)) TOTALNETVALUE, --累计净值 '' YEARRATE, --本期年化收益率 '' SEVENYEARRATE,--7日年化收益率 CAST((#{netUnitValue}) as Char(200)) FUNDINCOME, --万份收益 '' salerate,--销售费率 'N' PRODTYPE, --产品类型 '' DUEYIELD, -- 到期收益率 '' DUEDATE, -- 实际到期日 '' LOWESTYIELD, -- 最低收益率 '' HIGHESTYIELD, -- 最高收益率 '' MONTHYIELD,-- 月度收益率 '' QUARTERYIELD, -- 季度收益率 '' SEMIANNUALYIELD,-- 半年度收益率
(case when v1.VALUATION = 0 then '' else CAST(( #{ netUnitValue }- v1.VALUATION / v1.VALUATION) as Char(200)) end ) as DAILYINCREASE, --日涨幅（T日净值-(T-1)日净值）/(T-1)日净值*100%
(case when v1.VALUATION = 0 then '' else CAST((#{netUnitValue}-v1.VALUATION/v1.VALUATION/1*365) as Char(200)) end ) as DAILYYEARINCREASE, --年化日涨幅 日涨幅/1*365*100%
(case when v2.VALUATION = 0 then '' else CAST((#{netUnitValue}-v2.VALUATION/v2.VALUATION) as Char(200)) end ) as WEEKLYINCREASE, --周涨幅（T日净值-（T-7）日净值）/(T-7日净值)*100%
(case when v2.VALUATION = 0 then '' else CAST((#{netUnitValue}-v2.VALUATION/v2.VALUATION/7*365) as Char(200)) end ) as WEEKLYYEARINCREASE, --年化周涨幅 近一周涨跌幅/7*365*100%
(case when v3.VALUATION = 0 then '' else CAST((#{netUnitValue}-v3.VALUATION/v3.VALUATION) as Char(200)) end ) as MONTHLYINCREASE,--月涨幅（T日净值-(T-1个月)净值/ (T-1个月）日净值*100%
(case when v3.VALUATION = 0 then '' else CAST((#{netUnitValue}-v3.VALUATION/v3.VALUATION/30*365) as Char(200)) end ) as MONTHLYYEARINCREASE,--年化月涨幅 近1月涨跌幅/近1月天数*365*100%
(case when v4.VALUATION = 0 then '' else CAST((#{netUnitValue}-v4.VALUATION/v4.VALUATION) as Char(200)) end ) as QUARTERINCREASE, --季涨幅（T日净值-(T-3个月)净值/ (T-3个月）日净值*100%
(case when v4.VALUATION = 0 then '' else CAST((#{netUnitValue}-v4.VALUATION/v4.VALUATION/90*365) as Char(200)) end ) as QUARTERYEARINCREASE, --年化季涨幅 近3月涨跌幅/近3月天数*365*100%
(case when v5.VALUATION = 0 then '' else CAST((#{netUnitValue}-v5.VALUATION/v5.VALUATION) as Char(200)) end ) as SEMIANNUALINCREASE, --半年涨幅（T日净值-(T-6个月)净值/ (T-6个月）日净值*100%
(case when v5.VALUATION = 0 then '' else CAST((#{netUnitValue}-v5.VALUATION/v5.VALUATION/180*365) as Char(200)) end ) as SEMIANNUALYEARINCREASE, --年化半年涨幅 近6月涨跌幅/近6月天数*365*100%
(case when v6.VALUATION = 0 then '' else CAST((#{netUnitValue}-v6.VALUATION/v6.VALUATION) as Char(200)) end ) as ANNUALINCREASE, --年涨幅（T日净值-(T-1年)净值/ (T-1年）日净值*100%
(case when v6.VALUATION = 0 then '' else CAST((#{netUnitValue}-v6.VALUATION/v6.VALUATION) as Char(200)) end ) as ANNUALYEARINCREASE, --年化年涨幅 近1年涨跌幅 CAST(#{netUnitValue}-1,as Char) as SinceEstablishIncrease,--成立以来涨跌幅 （T日净值-1）*100%
'' HisRate,--历史收益率 '' DivAmt,--单位分红金额 '' RegisterDate,--权益登记日 '' DividendDate --红利下发日 FROM FIN_PRODUCT PRO left join (select FINPROD_ID,IFNULL(VALUATION,0) VALUATION from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION where FINPROD_ID= #{prodId} and VAL_DATE=str_to_date(#{cdate},'%y-%m-%d')-1 ) v1 on PRO.FINPROD_ID=v1.FINPROD_ID
left join (select FINPROD_ID,IFNULL(VALUATION,0) VALUATION from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION where FINPROD_ID= #{prodId} and VAL_DATE=str_to_date(#{cdate},'%y-%m-%d')-7) v2 on PRO.FINPROD_ID=v2.FINPROD_ID
left join (select FINPROD_ID,IFNULL(VALUATION,0) VALUATION from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION where FINPROD_ID= #{prodId} and VAL_DATE=add_months(str_to_date(#{cdate},'%y-%m-%d'),-1) ) v3 on PRO.FINPROD_ID=v3.FINPROD_ID
left join (select FINPROD_ID,IFNULL(VALUATION,0) VALUATION from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION where FINPROD_ID= #{prodId} and VAL_DATE=add_months(str_to_date(#{cdate},'%y-%m-%d'),-3)) v4 on PRO.FINPROD_ID=v4.FINPROD_ID
left join (select FINPROD_ID,IFNULL(VALUATION,0) VALUATION from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION where FINPROD_ID= #{prodId} and VAL_DATE=add_months(str_to_date(#{cdate},'%y-%m-%d'),-6)) v5 on PRO.FINPROD_ID=v5.FINPROD_ID
left join (select FINPROD_ID,IFNULL(VALUATION,0) VALUATION from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION where FINPROD_ID= #{prodId} and VAL_DATE=add_months(str_to_date(#{cdate},'%y-%m-%d'),-12)) v6 on PRO.FINPROD_ID=v6.FINPROD_ID
WHERE PRO.FINPROD_ID=#{prodId}
